parts.name: K1 sheet cost under scattered cue damage: r_all(vote) - r_all(vguard), cue@0
K2 (a) sheet cost with no event: r_all(vote) - r_all(vguard), none@0
K2 (b) sheet cost under misreads with no event: r_all(vote, none@0) - r_all(vguard, none@1)
K3 (a) R1 = (1/2) sum over sizes 4, 8 of u(vguard, memory@1) - u(vms, memory@1)
K3 (b) the share kept: R1(vguard) - k R1(vpool)
K4 R0 = (1/2) sum over sizes 4, 8 of u(vguard, memory@0) - u(vms, memory@0)
K5 W1 = (1/2) sum over sizes 4, 8 of u(vguard, memory@1) - u(vote, memory@0)
K6 (a) u(vpool) - u(vguard) in correlated damage, 4 x 4, sigma 0
K6 (b) u(vpool) - u(vguard) in correlated damage, 4 x 4, sigma 1
K6 (c) u(vguard) - u(vote) in correlated damage, 4 x 4, sigma 0
K6 (c) u(vguard, correlated@1) - u(vote, correlated@0), 4 x 4
K7 u(vguard) - u(vote) in the 4 x 4 patch, none@0
K7 u(vguard, none@1) - u(vote, none@0) in the 4 x 4 patch

statements.claim: under scattered cue damage the guarded controller's false alarms cost intact tissue within the confirmed bound
statements.rule: HOLDS if r_all(vote) - r_all(vguard) in cue@0 <= 0.01, else FAILS

statements.claim: with no event its false alarms cost intact tissue within the confirmed bound, and under misreads within AR003's E9 bound
statements.rule: HOLDS if r_all(vote) - r_all(vguard) in none@0 <= 0.002 and r_all(vote, none@0) - r_all(vguard, none@1) <= 0.01, else FAILS

statements.claim: under misread cues the guard keeps the pooled detector's recovery over the confirmed controller
statements.rule: HOLDS if R1 = (1/2) sum over sizes 4, 8 of u(vguard, memory@1) - u(vms, memory@1) >= 0.01 and R1(vguard) - 0.25 R1(vpool) >= 0.0, else FAILS

statements.claim: at sigma 0 it keeps the confirmed controller's hits (non-inferiority)
statements.rule: HOLDS if R0 = (1/2) sum over sizes 4, 8 of u(vguard, memory@0) - u(vms, memory@0) >= -0.01, else FAILS

statements.claim: under misread cues the controller still beats the best fixed policy
statements.rule: HOLDS if W1 = (1/2) sum over sizes 4, 8 of u(vguard, memory@1) - u(vote, memory@0) >= 0.12, else FAILS

statements.claim: the blind spot, measured: where body and record share the error the guard gives up at most a measured part of the pooled detector's worth, and keeps at least a measured part of its worth over the vote
statements.rule: HOLDS if u(vpool) - u(vguard) in correlated damage at 4 x 4 is at most 0.4 at sigma 0 and 0.37 at sigma 1, and u(vguard) - u(vote) there is at least 0.08 at sigma 0 and 0.02 at sigma 1 (against the vote's sigma-0 run), else FAILS

statements.claim: it gives up nothing to the vote where nothing needs correcting (non-inferiority)
statements.rule: HOLDS if u(vguard) - u(vote) in the 4 x 4 patch is at least -0.005 in none@0, and u(vguard, none@1) - u(vote, none@0) >= -0.005, else FAILS
